success.name: success
success.explanation: The module successfully completed the requested task.

open_err.name: open_err
open_err.explanation: Error loading or opening the PAM module.

symbol_err.name: symbol_err
symbol_err.explanation: Required symbol not found in the PAM module.

service_err.name: service_err
service_err.explanation: Error in service configuration or service not found.

perm_denied.name: perm_denied
perm_denied.explanation: Operation not permitted due to insufficient privileges.

auth_err.name: auth_err
auth_err.explanation: Authentication failed or error occurred during authentication.

cred_insufficient.name: cred_insufficient
cred_insufficient.explanation: Provided credentials are insufficient to proceed.

authinfo_unavail.name: authinfo_unavail
authinfo_unavail.explanation: Required authentication information is not available.

user_unknown.name: user_unknown
user_unknown.explanation: The user is not known to the system.

maxtries.name: maxtries
maxtries.explanation: Maximum number of authentication attempts exceeded.

new_authtok_reqd.name: new_authtok_reqd
new_authtok_reqd.explanation: A new authentication token is required (e.g., password change needed).

session_err.name: session_err
session_err.explanation: Error in session setup or management.

no_module_data.name: no_module_data
no_module_data.explanation: The module has no data available for this operation.

conv_err.name: conv_err
conv_err.explanation: Communication error between PAM and the application.

authtok_err.name: authtok_err
authtok_err.explanation: Error related to the authentication token or password.

authtok_recover_err.name: authtok_recover_err
authtok_recover_err.explanation: Unable to recover or reset the authentication token.

authtok_lock_busy.name: authtok_lock_busy
authtok_lock_busy.explanation: The authentication token is locked by another process.

authtok_disable_aging.name: authtok_disable_aging
authtok_disable_aging.explanation: Unable to disable password aging policy.

try_again.name: try_again
try_again.explanation: Operation failed; caller should retry the operation.

ignore.name: ignore
ignore.explanation: Module does not contribute to the success or failure decision.

abort.name: abort
abort.explanation: Critical error; authentication stack should abort.

authtok_expired.name: authtok_expired
authtok_expired.explanation: User password/token has expired and must be changed.

module_unknown.name: module_unknown
module_unknown.explanation: The specified PAM module is unknown or not found.

bad_item.name: bad_item
bad_item.explanation: Invalid item or parameter passed to the module.

conv_again.name: conv_again
conv_again.explanation: Application should retry the conversation with the user.

incomplete.name: incomplete
incomplete.explanation: Operation was not completed (e.g., multi-step process).

default.name: default
default.explanation: Catch-all for any return value not explicitly specified.

ignore.name: ignore
ignore.explanation: Ignore this return value and continue with the next module in the stack.

bad.name: bad
bad.explanation: Mark the entire stack as failed but continue processing remaining modules.

die.name: die
die.explanation: Terminate immediately and return failure. Do not process remaining modules.

ok.name: ok
ok.explanation: Mark as success but continue processing remaining modules.

done.name: done
done.description: Terminate immediately as success (if no prior errors)
done.explanation: Terminate immediately and return success if no prior errors. Otherwise continue normally.

reset.name: reset
reset.description: Reset state and continue from clean slate
reset.explanation: Reset the PAM state and continue from a clean slate.
